definitions.meaning: a report is a loud noise such as a gunshot or explosion
a variant spelling of bhang, the cannabis preparation from India

clue.text: Entrance of a victorious procession curtailed

explanation.definitionFit: An atrium is the entrance hall or court of a building, so it serves as an entrance.

definitions.meaning: ... is the printing method of moulding letters from molten metal
an actor who is ... is stuck with one kind of role

definitions.meaning: a tailless amphibian that croaks and leaps
the loop on a belt that holds a sword or bayonet

definitions.meaning: the armoured, horned African or Asian animal

corn that goes through the mill to be ground
